name: Jackson Ballinger
strengths: Ballinger is a physical inline blocker who drives defenders and finishes with intent at the point of attack.
Ballinger shows modern TE versatility -- attached, flexed, and motion lead-block looks.
Ballinger hunts second-level blocks and plays through the whistle with a hot motor.
Ballinger moves well enough for 6-5 / 230 to release into intermediate routes and create after the catch.
weaknesses: Ballinger's route stems still round at times -- needs sharper sink/breaks vs Power 4 linebackers.
comparison: Ballinger comps to Dawson Knox -- 6-5 class TE who wins first as a physical blocker with developmental receiving upside (size-matched to Ballinger's 6-5 / 230 mold).
projection: Ballinger projects as develop into the TE room, earn early inline/blocking package snaps, then compete for a starting Y role -- starter upside as a complete blocker-first tight end with growing receive traits.
schemeFit: Ballinger fits Faulkner as an inline/move TE who can lead-block and threaten intermediate windows.
insiderNotes: Vault film desk on Jackson Ballinger via On3->Hudl (Centerburg 2025 junior): 6-5 / 230 TE out of Centerburg, OH. Florida 2027 commit.
